note: Three frozen benchmark cases. allowed_paths and immutable_paths are ADVISORY documentation of what each case is meant to permit -- in THIS version of the harness NOTHING enforces them: there is no filesystem sandbox, no out-of-process snapshot/diff, no post-arm path check. A future sandboxed runner MUST enforce them (see benchmarks/README.md, 'Trial integrity -- NOT IMPLEMENTED in this version'). case_fingerprint = first 64 hex of sha256(cat <prompt_file> <acceptance_check>) -- the two-file case definition (prompt + check ONLY). It is retained purely as scorecard.py's control/treatment pairing key: the scorer only checks that a paired control and treatment record carry the SAME value, it never recomputes it from disk. If a case is deliberately regoldened (its prompt or check edited), recompute the value by hand -- see benchmarks/README.md, 'Recomputing a case_fingerprint'. Every acceptance_check exits 1 against the starting sandbox file and exits 0 only after a trial completes the task. The operator resolves and runs every acceptance_check (and its check_<id>.sh) from a PRISTINE copy of benchmarks/cases/ outside the trial worktree -- never the arm's copy in its own worktree -- see benchmarks/README.md and plugins/sefi-core/skills/run-sefi-benchmark/SKILL.md.
